summary: Nora can make a short video clip when asked, delivered to the chat a few minutes later as a link. It ships switched off.
details: A clip is 15 seconds at 480P, in portrait 3:4 unless the operator sets another ratio.
She starts the clip and carries on; the link arrives in the same chat when it is ready, and she says it stops working after 24 hours.
A daily limit (one clip a day by default) is checked before anything is spent, and a restart does not reset it. A clip the service failed does not count.
With reference photos switched on, she can use a photo already sent in the chat, or her own picture, never a link from the web.
limitations: Off until the operator turns it on: it needs the compute poller and the MiniMax CN key.
The link opens only on a device that can reach mainland China's Aliyun storage, and only for 24 hours.
Not yet tried live: the first 15 second clip, its real quota cost, and how reliably Nora chooses this tool are still to be measured.
